title: Rana Tigrina
overview: Rana Tigrina is an experimental sci-fi short film exploring the fragile boundary between human consciousness and animal instinct.  A street boy becomes the subject of a disturbing experiment led by Dr. Zoro — a man obsessed with evolution, control, and breaking the limits of nature. What follows is not just transformation… but awakening.  This film blends surreal storytelling, raw performances, and psychological tension to create an experience rather than a narrative.
